intro.caption: The workshop is frozen solid. Snow drifts through the halls; the conveyor belts stand still under ice.

intro.text: Nick? Nick, can you hear me? I'm in the Clock Tower office. The door's iced shut.
It was Jack Frost. He froze the whole workshop in one night. He was laughing, Nick. Like he'd been promised something.

choice.text: Hang on, Holly. I'll have you thawed out by teatime.

then.text: Make it before teatime. The kettle's frozen too.

choice.text: Then he answers for it. Where is he?

then.text: On top of the Clock Tower, last I saw. You'll need the tower thawed first.

choice.text: Promised something? By whom? Frost doesn't have friends.

then.text: He does now, apparently. Somebody's paying for all this ice.

intro.text: The three furnaces are out: the Toy Line to the west, the Wrapping Hall to the east, the Stables to the north.
Light them with your lantern. And don't stand about in the cold. Warm up by the braziers when you can.

start.text: The ice round the terrace is thin, Nick. Fall in and you'll go straight through.

first_furnace.text: That's one! Feel that? Those pipes run straight up the Clock Tower, Nick.

second_furnace.text: Two lit. The ice on the tower is starting to drip.

all_lit.text: All three! The ice on the Clock Tower is melting. Climb up, Nick. He's on the roof.

cold.text: You're turning blue! Get to a fire, quickly.

cold_again.text: Warm up, Nick! Find a brazier or a lantern.

climb_low.text: Nipping at noses — that's my whole song! But this year I'm the face of winter.

climb_high.text: Come on up, old man. That clock's been stuck since I got here!

boss_intro.text: Well, well. Saint Nick, all out of breath.
Hit me all you like. This ice doesn't melt for anybody.
Nick, the crank on the column turns the clock's hand. Every pipe up there is hot now...

frost_armoured.text: Ha! Is that a punch or a pat on the head?

frost_armoured_2.text: Solid ice, Nicky. Try again next century.

frost_missed.text: Missed me! Lovely bit of steam, though.

phase_1.text: Ow! You think this is about me? The Benefactor's got bigger plans than me!

phase_2.text: Fine! FINE! You want winter? Have ALL of it!

outro.caption: The last of the steam clears. Jack Frost staggers to the edge of the tower, dripping.

outro.text: This isn't over! You'll see. Everyone will see!

outro.caption: He vanishes in a howling blizzard. Down in the stables, Blitzen is caught in the gust, and something cracks.
The workshop thaws. In the meltwater on the tower roof, flakes of gold glint where Frost stood.

outro.text: Sir... before the freeze, men in red caps from the White House came to inspect the vault, sir.
Inspect the vault? Nobody told me.
